meta.name: mtls-configuration
meta.description: Configure mutual TLS (mTLS) for zero-trust service-to-service communication. Use when implementing zero-trust networking, certificate management, or securing internal service communication.

copy.tagline: 配置服务间双向 TLS 认证,建立零信任安全通信
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在服务之间启用相互 TLS 认证来加固通信安全
copy.tagline_en: Configure mutual TLS for services to enable zero-trust communication
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to secure internal service communication with mTLS.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会指导你为服务间通信配置双向 TLS(mTLS):搭建证书层级、迁移到零信任模式、轮换并监控证书,以及排查 TLS 握手问题。
howto.when: 当你在实现零信任网络、证书管理、服务间通信加密等场景,或需要排查 TLS 握手问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我为服务 A 到服务 B 的通信配置 mTLS
say.note: Claude 会给出证书层级与配置步骤

say.text: 怎么把 mTLS 从 PERMISSIVE 逐步迁到 STRICT?
say.note: Claude 会说明渐进迁移的做法

say.text: 我的 TLS 握手报错了,帮我排查一下
say.note: Claude 会沿证书链逐项检查

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude guides you through configuring mutual TLS (mTLS) between services: building a certificate hierarchy, moving to zero-trust, rotating and monitoring certs, and debugging TLS handshake failures.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you work on zero-trust networking, certificate management, or service-to-service encryption, or need to debug TLS handshake issues.

say_en.text: Help me set up mTLS for service A talking to service B
say_en.note: Claude outlines the cert hierarchy and config steps

say_en.text: How do I move mTLS from PERMISSIVE to STRICT?
My TLS handshake is failing, help me debug it
